🔥 stackyard | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing and cleaning up multiple SDKs and toolchains on a developer's machine to optimize disk space and fix environment configuration issues.
✨ Key Features: • Finds all installed SDKs and toolchains (Flutter, Node.js, Android SDK, Xcode, Java, Python, .NET, Gradle, etc.) • Shows which projects use each SDK version
📖 Summary: Stackyard is a free, open-source desktop application for Windows and macOS that helps developers manage their software development kits (SDKs) and toolchains. It identifies all installed SDKs, tracks which projects use them, and provides one-click solutions to fix broken setups and free up disk space by removing unused versions.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 thehumanbox | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a free, accessible, and client-side civilization simulation sandbox where users can observe or interact with emergent societal development.
✨ Key Features: • Autonomous tribal development (language, culture, cities, religion, war, treaties) • Runs entirely in the browser via WebAssembly (no server, no LLM)
📖 Summary: The Human Box is a free, browser-based civilization sandbox simulation written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. It allows users to observe or influence autonomous tribes as they develop languages, cultures, technologies, and engage in complex societal interactions from the stone age to the computer age, all running client-side without a server or LLM.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ gsc | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the detection, proof, and verification of code vulnerabilities within CI/CD pipelines to improve application security.
✨ Key Features: • SAST, SCA, secrets, and IaC scanning with 69 detectors • Automated Proof-of-Concept (PoC) generation for findings • Proof-of-Fix verification to ensure vulnerabilities are actually resolved • Self-learning engine that re-scores detectors and deactivates noisy patterns
📖 Summary: GSC is a self-learning AppSec platform that automates the process of detecting, proving, and fixing security vulnerabilities in code. It generates runnable proof-of-concepts for findings, verifies fixes through re-running exploits, and integrates into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 bybit-ws | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated, AI-driven cryptocurrency futures trading on Bybit with robust risk management.
✨ Key Features: • AI-Native Trading Engine • Bollinger Bands + AI Scoring for Entry • Automated LONG/SHORT Trading • Advanced Risk Management (Stop-loss, Take-profit, Trailing, DCA) • Deposit Protection (Circuit Breaker, BlackSwan, Anti-ludomania)
📖 Summary: Bybit-WS is an AI-native trading engine designed for 24/7 automated trading on the Bybit futures market. It utilizes Bollinger Bands combined with a 9-metric AI scoring system for entry points, and incorporates advanced risk management and deposit protection features.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 watchstate | PHP
🎯 Primary Use Case: Synchronizing user playback state across different media server platforms (Plex, Jellyfin, Emby) in a self-hosted environment.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-users support via identities • Sync backends play state (many-to-many or one-way) • Backup backends play state into portable format • Receive webhook events from media backends • Find record issues with Media Health
📖 Summary: WatchState is a self-hosted PHP service designed to synchronize playback progress across multiple media servers like Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. It operates without relying on third-party services, offering features such as multi-user support, webhook event handling, and the ability to back up playback states.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
